description: Instructors teaching in a term whose last or first name contains the given text, from the UMD Schedule of Classes autocomplete. Pass the returned `name` as the instructor to testudo_soc_search_courses. No login needed.

query.description: Part of a last or first name, at least two characters, e.g. "gonz"

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

name: testudo_soc_autocomplete_instructors

name.description: Display name to pass to testudo_soc_search_courses, e.g. "Gonzalez, Elias"

title: Autocomplete instructors
